title: 2.11 Big and Small
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Things, Numbers and Colors
unit_outcome: Name places and things with un/una and el/la, count them, and say their color and size with the right ending.
goal: Say a thing is big, small, new or used, and that two things are the same or different.
grammar_function: El/La + noun + es + adjective; Los/Las + plural + son iguales/diferentes.
speaking_outcome: Describe the size and age of things.
